QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_16

answer.text: Closed-ended debt funds with illiquid assets, REITs, InvITs

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Table 1.1, 'dual' category includes structures with illiquid assets but liquid instruments: close-ended debt funds with illiquid assets, REITs, InvITs. The Trap: Other options are pure traditional or pure alternative. Cross-Exam Context: Intermediate classification. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Explain REIT/InvIT as a bridge product before pitching pure Cat III AIFs.
